name: panel-tabs
title: Panel Tabs
description: The rules of the shell panel's tabs as one pure reducer — references with canonical keys, a back-stack per tab, insert after the current tab, one preview tab, a soft cap of 10 with Undo, auto-close, Recently closed — plus the saved shape and the ?panel= URL codec.

meta.whenToUse: Holding the shell panel's open tabs — dispatch its actions from usePanelTabs, save serializePanelTabs per workspace and sync encodePanelParam with the URL.
meta.whenNotToUse: In-page section tabs (Tabs, RouteTabs, ViewTabs) — they have no preview, cap or back-stack.
